text: 你发现自己根本没有准备好面对眼前这些异界恐怖之物。你手无寸铁，无法有效反击。你几乎凭借顽强意志挣脱了第一只怪物的抓握，但更多怪物很快从雾中出现，没过多久，你就被它们压倒性的数量制服了。
你尽力反抗它们，却毫无用处。没有合适的武器，你只能任这些非自然的畸形怪物摆布。
它们没有立刻杀死你，而是把你拖向一栋着火的房子；你一路踢打、尖叫。阴燃的灰烬堆上，尸体堆积如山，已经被点燃。你还看见废墟间散落着各式珠宝和宝石——足足有一把又一把。火光在被掠夺来的黄金和宝石上灿然闪烁。
你来不及欣赏这些东西，也来不及细看眼前的景象，便被迅速扔进火中。在剧痛中活活烧死时，你最后看见那些生物在渐盈凸月下、浓雾中蹒跚摇晃地跳着舞，赞颂它们那奇怪而无法想象的神。
你死了，被献祭给一位旧日支配者。你在埃斯伯里的旅程结束。结局。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 231
text: You find yourself woefully unprepared to deal with the otherworldly horrors that are in front of you. Unarmed, you’re unable to fight back effectively. You nearly escape the first creature’s grasp through sheer tenacity, but more of them quickly emerge from the mist, and it’s not long before you’re subdued by their sheer weight of numbers.
You struggle against them as best you can, but it’s to no avail. Without a proper weapon, you’re at the mercy of these unnatural and misshapen things.

They don’t kill you right away. Instead, they carry you, kicking and screaming, toward a burning house. Piled atop the smoldering heaps of ashes are mounds of corpses that have already been set alight. You also spot various pieces of jewelry and scattered gemstones strewn among the wreckage—entire fistfuls of them. The firelight reflects brilliantly off the looted gold and gems.

You don’t have time to admire them or to wonder at the spectacle before you, as you are swiftly fed to the flames. As you burn alive in agonizing pain, the last sight you see is the creatures dancing a lurching, shuffling jig through the fog beneath the gibbous moon, giving praise to their strange and unimaginable god. You have died, offered up as a sacrifice to a Great Old One. Your visit to Esbury is over.
